readiness_steps.title: Understand
readiness_steps.body: Work out whether this is a grant, tender, quote, panel, expression of interest or market sounding.

readiness_steps.title: Fit
readiness_steps.body: Check eligibility, location, supplier category, insurance, licences, experience and whether the job is too big.

readiness_steps.title: Prepare
readiness_steps.body: Gather capability statement, ABN, registrations, referees, policies, quotes, budget, method and delivery proof.

readiness_steps.title: Respond
readiness_steps.body: Answer the exact criteria. Show value, local knowledge, risk control, timing, capacity and evidence.

readiness_steps.title: Submit
readiness_steps.body: Use the official portal, leave time for upload problems, and record the version, date and contact person.

readiness_steps.title: Improve
readiness_steps.body: If successful, deliver and keep proof. If unsuccessful, request a debrief and improve the next response.

capability_statement: Who you are and where you work
Goods, services or works you can actually deliver
First Nations, local, social or environmental value if true and relevant
Key people, equipment, partners and capacity limits
response_checks: The tender closes after the realistic preparation time needed
The supplier can meet mandatory requirements
The pricing covers labour, materials, admin, risk and reporting
The response answers every weighted criterion
Cultural authority and permissions are handled with care
The final submission is made through the official portal
stop_signs: Mandatory insurance, licence, accreditation or prior experience is missing
The job needs cashflow or staffing the supplier does not have
The scope relies on cultural knowledge or Country without permission
The deadline creates rushed, unsafe or misleading claims
The opportunity is better suited to a partner, subcontract role or future round
